description: Lignes régulières de transport public TransGironde is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Ressourcerie datalocale. As the organising authority for intercity public transport, the Gironde Department operates 79 regular lines (59 network lines including 7 summer and 20 school service lines) and hundreds of school services. With 390 municipalities served, the TransGironde network is distinguished by its scale and an increasingly complete offer. Coverage: Ressourcerie datalocale. The portal shows the English title as "Regular TransGironde public transport lines" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Ressourcerie datalocale. Its keywords include transgironde, gironde, autocar, conseil-departemental. The listing shows 2 download or service links in KMZ, KML. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
